title: Senior Recruiter (Contract)
description: About Us: Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com. Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here. Overview: Seismic is a global enterprise SaaS product company engineering the future of enterprise growth through AI-native sales enablement. Our unified platform, the Seismic Enablement Cloud™ delivers the intelligent automation, predictive insights, and context-aware tools customer-facing teams need to win deals faster, build lasting buyer trust, and scale revenue predictably. Trusted by over 2,000 global enterprise customers and more than one million daily active users worldwide, we build high-impact software that redefines how modern businesses operate. Headquartered in the US, Seismic operates across global hubs in the USA, Canada, EMEA, and APAC. Our Hyderabad hub is a strategic co-center of Seismic’s global business model. Operating as direct partners with our international offices, our India teams drive end-to-end execution across Product & Engineering, Field Operations & Services, Finance, IT, Security and HR. Are you passionate about finding and engaging top talent? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy environment? If so, we want you on our team! We are looking for an experienced Contract Recruiter (10+ years) to own end-to-end hiring for our SaaS product teams, covering both technical and non-technical roles. You will partner closely with global stakeholders (US preferred) and local hiring managers in Hyderabad, bringing strong sourcing fundamentals, a results-driven mindset, and a passion for candidate experience. This is a contract role of a minimum of 6 months, based out of our Hyderabad office. Who you are:: 10+ years of recruiting experience, including working experience at a product based or SaaS company. Proven end-to-end recruiting expertise, covering both technical and non-technical requirements. Strong sourcing fundamentals, with the ability to identify talent through traditional and non-traditional channels. Experience managing global (US preferred) and local stakeholders and delivering results. Hands-on experience running hiring events independently. Prior hands-on experience with, and working knowledge of, the iCIMS ATS is a must. An understanding of Ashby is an added advantage. Passion for candidate engagement and candidate experience. Results driven, with a strong team player attitude. Should be based in Hyderabad and comfortable working from the Hyderabad office 3 days a week. What you'll be doing:: Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through screening, interviews, offer and close, for technical and non-technical roles. Partner with global and local hiring managers to define role requirements, hiring plans, timelines and interview processes. Source talent proactively through traditional channels (job boards, LinkedIn, referrals) and non-traditional ones (communities, GitHub, events, networks, talent mapping). Plan and run hiring events independently, from planning to execution. Deliver an outstanding candidate experience with timely communication, clear expectations and strong engagement through to joining. Keep hiring pipelines, dashboards and candidate data accurate in the ATS, and report on funnel metrics and progress regularly. Advise hiring managers on market trends, compensation benchmarks and talent availability. Collaborate with the wider Talent Acquisition team to share best practices and hit team hiring goals. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

The Lead Recruiter will build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, business stakeholders, and recruitment vendors to ensure timely closure of approved requisitions. The position requires a high degree of ownership, collaboration, and accountability, with regular interaction across all levels of the organization, including Principals, senior management, and Human Resources teams. The role will also involve providing guidance to junior recruiters, driving recruitment best practices, and supporting continuous improvement in talent acquisition processes. Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results People Foster a positive, collaborative, and engaging team environment that encourages teamwork, accountability, and professional growth. Supervise and guide team members by effectively assigning responsibilities, monitoring recruitment progress, and ensuring timely closure of open positions. Client Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers to understand their talent needs, hiring priorities, and expectations. Research industry trends relating to job fairs, professional organizations, job postings, and networking opportunities. Initiates first point of contact with qualified potential candidates to schedule/conduct interviews and provide information about the organization and position. Reviews application and background release forms submitted by candidates to ensure work history, education, training, job skills, and salary requirements are completed.
